Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • The Station Title of this Station is Rectilinear Estate.
  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "Confluence of the Inner Lands".
Name of the Soundtrack Length (mm:ss)
Rectilinear Estate 02:20
Grid of Homesteads 02:38

Fun Facts[]

  • The name of this station alludes to the original station name of Wong E-Tech Station (namely Jawai Village Station) as Jawai was the original name of this area.
  • This station is the third station to be inserted between two existing stations after Metro Stone and Kamelen. This is also the first such instance outside of the main Los Sengas Continent.
  • This station is the only inserted station in which island platforms are used.
  • While the Nawis Railway and Nazca Railway parts do not share exit and platform numbers, and their concourses are not structurally connected, as cross-platform interchange is possible between New Edward Line and Southern Corridor platforms, the Nazca Railway and Nawis Railway stations are seen as one station.

History[]

  • April 9 2020: Due to the construction of this station, the New Edward Line station numbers of Java Beach Station and Python Delta Station have been changed to 4-10 and 4-11 respectively.[7]
  • April 24 2020: This station completed construction.[8]
  • April 25 2020: New Edward Line trains began stopping at this station.
  • June 13 2020: This station had been sabotaged.[9]
  • February 3 2023: Platforms 3 and 4 have been added to enhance transferability between New Edward Line and Southern Corridor.[10]
  • June 22 2026: This Station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[11]

title: Twenty-Second Continent
safeHtml:
Twenty-second Continent is District Number 22 of Los Sengas. It is also the third major continent to be discovered after Los Sengas Continent and Peckern Continent. The representative color of this district is gold. Currently, this district is managed by Soleil_de_minuit, and large development areas such as Diamond Pool and Halozy exist.

On May 4 2022, part of Airship Island was drawn into this district, but on May 6 2023, the entirety of Airship Island became a part of Peckern.

Twin Cliffs Station is a station on Abyss Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Yowah. Passengers may also use this station to change to Cadence Line, Neko Line (Twin Cliffs Station).

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is named after the fact that it is located between two cliffs at the time of its construction.
  • The Design of this station is similar to that of Justin Station. The Two concourses are not connected with each other.
  • The Station Control Room Entrance is located outside the station and is reached through a naturally generated cavern.
  • The Station Pillar (Temporary Pillars erected by the Railway Builder to mark the location of a new station) of this station has been preserved after the construction of this station.

History[]

  • November 9 2019: This Station began services. Abyss Line extends from Kong Corner Station to Shore Tip Station through this station and Sand Martin Checkpoint.
  • March 23 2022: Exit C is added to this station to connect to the StarTop Railway Station of the Same Name.[4]
  • February 28 2024: Exit C has been renamed from "StarTop Railway Cadence Line" to "L.S.R.C.S. Twin Cliffs Station".

Fun Facts[]

  • Despite being located in the same area as the first phase of Cadence Line between Yowah Point and Echo Cliffs, initial development of Cadence Line did not include this station when it began services on September 22 2018. However, one year later, as Nazca Railway constructed Twin Cliffs Station in Season 3 Episode 7, which was situated above the Cadence Line tracks in this area, many players began requesting for an interchange station with the Nazca Railway Station of the same name. After much investigation and probing, it was decided that there was sufficient room for a new station, and this station became included in Phase 3 Development of Cadence Line.
  • The StarTop Railway section and Phantasia Metro section of this station shares structure.

Typhoon Sixteen Street are several roads around Downtown Metropolis, each of which is named after a typhoon-related name.

Road List[]

  • Royal Road (N-S), named after Royal Observatory of Hong Kong.
  • Prapiroon Road (W-E), named after Typhoon Prapiroon in 2006.
  • Kaemi Street (W-E), named after Typhoon Kaemi in 2006.
  • Bilis Street (W-E), named after Typhoon Bilis in 2000.
  • Ewiniar Street (W-E), named after Typhoon Ewiniar in 2006
  • Jelawat Street (W-E, N-S), named after Tropical Storm Jelawat in 2006.

  • Bolaven Street (W-E, N-S), named after Tropical Storm Bolaven in 2005.
  • Tembin Street (W-E), named after Tropical Storm Tembin in 2005.
  • Kai Tak Street (W-E), named after Typhoon Kai Tak in 2005.
  • Kirogi Street (W-E), named after Typhoon Kirogi in 2005.
  • Longwang Street (W-E), named after Typhoon Longwang in 2005.
  • Damrey Street (W-E), named after Typhoon Damrey in 2005.
  • Dvorak Street (W-E), named after Dvorak technique, which is used to estimate tropical cyclone intensity.
  • Coriolis Street (W-E), named after Coriolis Force, a fictitious force that acts on objects in motion.
  • Fujiwara Street (W-E), named after Fujiwara Effect, a phenomenon that occurs to two nearby cyclonic.

Fun Facts[]

  • The name and design of this station corresponds to the Up Quark, one of the six types of Quarks.[4] To correspond to the element of "Up", the following elements are incorporated:
    • While the colored glass panes at the concourse, like Top Hill Bay Station, are located at the upper area of its corresponding glass, the Signs are no longer hung from above.
    • The Pink Wool of the pillars, while located at the upper location of the pillars, is not constructed at the top of the pillar.
  • While this station has the same altitude as Top Hill Bay Station, as this station is not constructed on top of the sea and is on top of the plains, the height difference between the concourse and the ground level is not as large as that of Top Hill Bay Station.

History[]

  • January 6 2020: This Station began services alongside Oasis Bay Line.
  • April 1 2022: This station began expansion of the Pegasus Line Part.
  • April 2 2022: This station completed expansion of the Pegasus Line Part. At the same day, Pegasus Line extends from Galileo Heights Station to this station.
  • December 29 2024: The Station Title of this station is announced through the monthly calender.[5]
  • March 9 2026: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[6]

While the Black wool is located at the bottom of each pillar for Downhill Pond Station, the black wool is located at the top of each pillar for this station.

title: Upper Bufly Tunnel
safeHtml:
Upper Bufly Tunnel is an underwater tunnel in NR Los Sengas Division. It is also the first underwater tunnel to exceed 2 km in length.

Description[]

  • Number of Tubes: 2
  • Length: 2560 m
  • Lines Served: West Ring Line
  • Location: Bufly Island Station - Droplet Island Station

Technical Information and Characteristics[]

  • This tunnel is the first Underwater Tunnel with 2 Tubes.
  • At over 2 km in length, it held the record for the longest underwater tunnel in Los Sengas until the completion of Comp Ward North Tunnel. However, it is still the longest underwater tunnel for West Ring Line.

Citations and References []

History[]

  • October 30 2016: This station began services alongside Flask Line.
  • May 16 2022: The Daybreaker Line Part of this station began expansion.
  • May 18 2022: The Daybreaker Line Platforms of this station completed expansion. At the same day, Daybreaker Line extends from Roundy Basin Station to this station.

title: Upper Rover Bridge
safeHtml:
Upper Rover Bridge is a bridge that is used by both Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division) and Route 1. It is also the second longest bridge in Los Sengas.

Description[]

  • Bridge Type: Suspension Bridge
  • Length: 3048 m
  • Number of Decks: Double-Deck
    • Upper Deck: Route 1 six-lane dual-carriageway
    • Lower Deck: Spare four-lane dual carraigeway, Urban Line, Urban Express Tracks
  • Lines Served: Urban Line, Urban Express
  • Routes Served: Route 1
  • Location: Rover Peninsula - The South of Upper Rover Station

Technical Information and Characteristics[]

  • The second longest bridge in Los Sengas at over 3km long.
  • A bridge used by both rail and road transport

Station Souvenir Hints (Now Demolished)[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.

  • Stars: 0
  • One player is enough.
  • Jump up the mountain to the south of the station and traverse across the mountain. Then, jump onto the station structure from the mountain.
  • Run along the station structure until you are near the souvenir. Then, jump onto the station souvenir platform.
  • The Station Souvenir comes in the form of an empty bucket.

History[]

  • June 3 2016: The Upper Rover Bridge connecting to this station began construction.[4]
  • June 4 2016: The Upper Rover Bridge and Rover Down Bridge completed construction.[5]
  • June 5 2016: The section between this station and Upper Rover Bridge completed construction.[6]
  • June 20 2016: This station began services alongside Urban Line.
  • April 29 2017: This station suffered from structural damage, but has since been recovered.[7]
  • July 22 2020: The Urban Line section of this station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[8]
  • December 24 2024: This station began expansion of the Rover Line Part.
  • December 25 2024: This station completed expansion of the Rover Line part, but Rover Line Platforms remain reserved.
  • January 13 2025: Rover Line extends from Rover Stadium Station to this station through Rotin Station.
  • January 21 2025: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[9]

Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • The Station Title of this Station is Transient Panoramascape.
  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "Of Soil and Splendor, Of Jest and Joy".
Name of the Soundtrack Length (mm:ss)
Transient Panoramascape 02:05
Glimmer in the Gale 03:09

Fun Facts[]

  • Despite being an elevated station, the platforms of this station are completely sealed off.
  • This Station, coupled with Blue Swamp Station, alludes to the word Vicissitudes in Chinese.
  • While Blue Swamp Station has water above the ceiling of the platforms and the concourse so that the concourse and the platform are visible with each other, this station has water on the floor in the middle of the Platform, as well as a skylight above the platform.
  • This Station uses blue concrete to allude to Iceland as ice is usually associated with the color blue, whereas Blue Swamp Station, despite its name, uses Green Concrete to allude to Greenland. [3]
  • While the Exits and the Platforms are at the same altitude of Y=70, as the Platforms are situated above a canal, this Station is considered an Elevated Station.

History[]

  • April 3 2018: This Station began services. Abyss Line is established.
  • November 17 2023: The Station Title Banner of this station is added.
  • April 1 2025: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[4]
  • April 23 2025: The Station Icon of this station is added.

Upward Line was Line Number U of NR Heaven Pacific Division. With 7 planned stations on the line, this line was confirmed to begin construction on May 31 2018, and would have ran between Frosty End and Clanet Hill. However, on July 20 2018, before construction of this line ever began, Heaven Pacific Division ended operations, and works on this line were aborted as a result.

Description []

Upward Line was one of the proposed lines of Nazca Railway Heaven Pacific Division. It would have ran in a north-south orientation.

This route would have been represented by Dark Blue Color on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and was Line Number U.

Station Souvenir Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 1
  • Walk Down the Stairs from the East Wing of the Concourse.
  • The Station Souvenir comes in the form of glass.

Station Gauntlet Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 3.5-4
  • Take Notes at the Stone Pillars outside the north side of the station, as well as the images on the ceiling.
  • Start Counting from above the Iron Block placed to the right.
  • Fill up the holes, but don't fill in too much.
  • The Station Gauntlet Souvenir comes in the form of a Piece of Light Blue Stained Glass Pane.

Fun Facts[]

  • The Platform 1 This Station features the first Through Service trains in Nazca Railway with West Ring Line The Three Pass Station.
  • Prior to the introduction of the Station Gauntlet in this Station, it used to have the hardest Station Souvenir. The Station Souvenir Requires two people to complete. Firstly, a Hexadecimal row of numbers featuring a set of shadow controls is located at the upper floor, whereas a player who could actually control the locks stands at the lower floor without any hints and could only be notified by the player at the shadow controls. Finally, all five of the locks have to be unlocked at the same time in order to get the Station Souvenir.[3]

History[]

  • April 11 2015: This station began services.
  • February 28 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[4]
  • January 6 2017: This station completed replacement of direction and platform signs.[5]
  • May 27 2017: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[6]
  • January 6 2021: The Luxter Line section of this station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[7]
  • April 20 2022: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[8]
  • July 1 2022: The "Station Gauntlet" of this station is set up.[9]

Urban Express is the Express Line of Urban Line. This line uses the letter "X" to represent "Express". Urban Express was established on August 8 2015 as the long-distance express service of Urban Line.

Urban Express is currently 41.04 km long, and has 5 stations.

Line Characteristics and Fun Facts[]

Main Line (Urban Line)[]

  • One of the six initially planned lines of NR Los Sengas Division.
  • This line runs entirely at the North-South orientation.
  • Except for the section between Metropolis and South Bay, which runs parallel with West Ring Line, the average interstation distance is longer than other Standard Railway Lines.
  • Most of the section between Metropolis and Upper Rover shares structure with Route 1.
  • An emergency platform is set up between Metropolis and High Mesa. While there were originally plans to set up a station there, this plan was ultimately scrapped.
  • Thie line passes through the most bridges among all Standard Railway Lines. (4 Bridges)
  • This line separates East Los Sengas from West Los Sengas. Areas to the east of Urban Line are East Los Sengas, whereas areas to the west of Urban Line are West Los Sengas.
  • The tunnel between Upper Rover Bridge and Upper Rover is also the first Dual Carriageway Tunnel in Los Sengas Division.
  • This line provides Express Services for the following lines:
    • East Ring Line: Metropolis to High Mesa. It skips Metro Spring Station and Cyan Loop Station, making the journey more direct.
    • Akashi Line: Seraphynx to Mei Fwong. It skips Minstrel Woods Station and makes the journey more direct.
  • While Seraphynx Station was not originally designed to be an Urban Line station, when considering the fact that passengers to and from Akashi Line and Daybreaker Line would have to travel down to Mei Fwong Station before connecting to other lines, it was ultimately decided that Urban Line would stop at Seraphynx Station.[2]

Express Line (Urban Express)[]

  • While this line is not a Veloduct, as the concept of Veloducts did not appear at the time of this line's establishment, it uses announcements in the style of Veloducts. However, as a result, Glacier Express, which will be established in the future, is not considered to be a part of the Veloducts either.
  • This line became the basis of Veloducts in the future.
  • Thie line was formerly the line which have not completed development and had the longest timespan without any development. (This line had not seen any development for three years and one month, from the completion of Rover Down Checkpoint on August 10 2015 until the completion of Intus Aquilo Gateway in S3E2 on September 21 2018). However, this record was broken in 2020 by Glacier Line on October 2020. At the time, Glacier Line did not have any development for three years and ten months.
  • The section between Metropolis and Tat Stone Hill has an interstation distance of 13.02 km. This broke the record of the longest interstation distance for Standard Railway Lines (Flask Line section between Flask East and Internal Sea East) and the entire Los Sengas Division (Alpha Line section between Metropolis and Comp Ward).

title: V-Stock
safeHtml:
The V-stock is a train designed by "New Horizons Technology" (The parent company of Nazca Railway) designed for Veloduct use based on the N-Stock.

Contents

  • 1 Technical Information
    • 1.1 Exterior and Outlook
    • 1.2 Variants
    • 1.3 Specifications
    • 1.4 Power Systems
  • 2 Vehicle Design
    • 2.1 Seats
    • 2.2 Train Interior
    • 2.3 Passenger Information Display System
    • 2.4 Car Doors
    • 2.5 Neutral Zone
  • 3 Fun Facts
  • 4 Application
  • 5 Related Trains
  • 6 Citations and References

Technical Information[]

Exterior and Outlook[]

  • Driver Cab Car Length: 25000 mm
  • Normal Car Length: 22000 mm
  • Width: 3000 mm
  • Height: 3750 mm
  • Total Length (9-Carriage): 204000 mm (204 m)
  • Track Gauge: 1432 mm
  • Car Doors: 3 doors on both sides for all carriages except the third and the seventh carriages. 5 doors on both sides for the third and the seventh carriages
  • Material: Titanium Alloy
  • Destination Indication: Full-Color LED, alternating between Route Name and Destination Name.

Variants[]

Code: D－Driver Cab, H－Control Car, M－Motor, P－Pantograph, T－Trailer

  • 9-Carriage: 5M4T (D-P-M-H-M-T(H)-M-P-D)

DV1xx - PV2xx - MV3xx - HV4xx - MV5xx - HV6xx - MV7xx - PV8xx - DV9xx

After the 100th Rolling Stock:
D91xxx - P92xxx - M93xxx - H94xxx - M95xxx - H96xxx - M97xxx - P98xxx - D99xxx

xx and xxx represents the order of rolling stock constructed.

Bold represents carriages with 5 doors, others represent carriages with 3 doors.

Specifications[]

This train uses the same components as the N-Stock, but has different maximum speeds.

  • Designed Maximum Speed: 145 km/h
  • Operational Maximum Speed (Los Sengas): 135 km/h
  • Acceleration: 4.5 km/h/s
  • Deceleration: 2-5 km/h/s

Power Systems[]

  • Electrification: 1500 V DC (Can be customized for support of 25000V 60Hz AC and alternation between AC and DC).
  • Current Collector: Wireless Pantograph
  • Braking system: Regenerative Braking blended with air brake.

Vehicle Design[]

Seats[]

All seats except for in the third and seventh carriages are horizontal seats that automatically changes direction upon reaching the destination. Alternatively, the orientation of the seats can also be manually configured. All seats feature headrests and artificial leateher. Seats in the third and seventh carriages are vertical seats featuring headrests and artificial leather.

Train Interior[]

Circular Plastic Rings and cylindrical handrails are set up between train doors, with an improved holding position for optimized touch. While there was formerly a hand rail in the middle of the car doors, as it affects the efficiency of passenger flow, they were later removed. To the left of every third door of the third and seventh carriages, a wheelchair space that can put up to two wheelchairs is also available to the left of the third door.

Passenger Information Display System[]

A 17.5-inch LCD screen is placed on the car door to play advertisements and news information, and two connected 17.5-inch display screens display train information, including the next station, the destination, the station layout and transfer information. In total, there are three 17.5-inch displays on the car door. However, for the V-Stock, another 17.5-inch display is set up perpendicular to the car door so that passengers on horizontal seats can view passenger information.

Car Doors[]

Car doors are 1500mm wide at 5-door carriages and 1300mm wide at 3-door carriages. All car doors are electrically operated. While the doors are quiet during operation, a sound indicatior will also sound when the doors are about to close to ensure passenger safety.

Neutral Zone[]

When trains pass through Neutral Zones, the Electrical Voltage becomes Zero, and a loud bang will be heard due to air pressure. However, they only exist in The Shuttle, and other areas are separated using insulators. Signs also exist to indicate the beginning and end of Neutral Zones.

Fun Facts[]

While this train is mechanically identical to the N-Stock, the facilities in each carriage are modified to fit the needs of Commuter Travel. However, the third and seventh carriages of the V-Stock are identical to that of the N-Stock.

Application[]

  • All Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division) Veloducts

This rolling stock is only used in the Veloduct as passenger capacity is lower. Therefore, during rush hour, the N-Stock is also used to facilitate passenger flow.

All V-Stock trains support up to nine carriages.

Related Trains[]

  • N-Stock: The base variant of this train.

Fun Facts[]

  • The design and layout of this station is similar to New Edward Line Aest Station with regards that both stations have an outdoors structure that is surrounded by two disconnected platforms. However, there are several differences between this station and Aest Station as follows:
    • Most of the Outdoor Space at Aest Station is not covered, whereas a cover is built above the station structure of this Station. This ensure that passengers in the station would not get wet even under rainy weather.
    • While Aest Station has an indoor space beneath the platforms, this Station does not have any indoor spaces except for the platforms.
    • As the two platforms at Aest are separated by tracks, with its tracks closer to the Station Park than the Platforms, that station is seen as having Side Platforms. However, the platforms in this station are linked by Connecting Passageways as the Platforms are closer to the Open Area than the Tracks in this Station. Therefore, this Station is seen as having a Separated Island Platforms.
  • This is the eighth Nazca Railway Station in which the Name of this Station shares the name of the District that houses the station itself, with the first seven being Katadelphia, Zootuary, TriPaw, Glacier, Intus Aquilo, Centopia and Coopol.

History[]

  • March 4 2026: This Station began construction.
  • March 6 2026: This Station completed construction.
  • March 7 2026: This Station began services.

title: Vanilla Bay Stabling Sidings
safeHtml:
Vanilla Bay Stabling Sidings is one of the stabling sidings of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division constructed for Sava Line. It is located to the east of the Vanilla Bay Station Concourse.

Contents

  • 1 Description
    • 1.1 Sidings
    • 1.2 Connecting Tracks
    • 1.3 Other Facts
  • 2 Gallery
  • 3 Citations and References

Description[]

Sidings[]

  • Four tracks in total
  • Each track has a capacity of four 4-carraige trains.

Connecting Tracks[]

The east end of the Stabling Sidings connect to Sava Line tracks leading to Savanna Central Station. The west end of the Stabling Sidings is the Vanilla Bay Station Concourse.

Other Facts[]

Besides of increasing the capacity for Sava Line, this Stabling Siding is also constructed with enhancing Sava Line dispatch frequencies in mind. The trains parked in this Stabling Siding are also managed by Sayler Depot.

Vayler North Station is a station on Swift Line and Phoenix Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Sava. Passengers may also use this station to change to Central-Yowah Railway Yowah Line (Vayler North Station) and SLT Line 211 (Vayler North NR Station Stop).

Fun Facts[]

  • The existence of Phoenix Line is first announced at this station.
  • This Station integrates the characteristics of Vayler Station and Swift Line.[3]
  • At the time of its construction, this station has the fourth most exits alongside Red Millet Station.
  • As Vayler North NR Station Stop is already constructed at the location of this station, the Swift Line Concourse and the rest of the station structure have to be constructed below that stop.
  • While Phoenix Line originally planned to stop at Vayler Station instead of this station, later coordiations with the developer of Sava had seen that, as Mayler Airport would turn into an airport open to the public, Phoenix Line is relocated to this station instead.

History[]

  • January 17 2021: This Station completed construction.[4]
  • January 18 2021: This station began services alongside Swift Line. However, as Phoenix Line have yet to begin development, the Phoenix Line platforms remain reserved.
  • April 22 2023: This station began setting up of Phoenix Line systems.
  • April 23 2023: This station completed setting up of Phoenix Line systems. At the same day, Phoenix Line extends from Bonyal Bay Station to this station through Bonyal North Station.

Station Souvenir Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 1
  • Go outside the station and find a river that has an opening under the ground level. Walk along the river until you find an entrance.
  • The Station Souvenir comes in the form of a Fishing Rod.

Station Gauntlet[]

  • The theme and challenge modes of this Station Gauntlet are as follows:
    • Solo
    • Premises
    • Sequence

Station Gauntlet Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 1.5
  • Only One Player is Required.
  • Take note of wool patterns at each house, measure the house sizes, and press the corresponding buttons in ascending order of house area.
  • The Station Gauntlet Souvenir comes in the form of a Gold Ingot.

History[]

  • June 10 2015: This station began services alongside Arcgo Line.
  • May 16 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[7]
  • December 12 2017: This station completed replacement of direction and platform signs.[8]
  • January 19 2021: This station began expansion.
  • January 20 2021: This station completed expansion. At the same day, Swift Line extends from Vayler North Station to this station, and this station also became the downward permanent terminus of Swift Line.
  • October 7 2022: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[9]
  • April 19 2023: The Station Title Banner of this station is added.
  • October 20 2024: As Swift Line extends to Mayler Airport 2 Station, Platform 4 is no longer used for turning around.
  • November 28 2024: The "Station Gauntlet" of this station is set up.[10]
  • February 23 2025: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[11]
  • June 21 2025: The Station Icon of this station is added.

title: Vector Bay Depot
safeHtml:
Vector Bay Depot is one of the depots of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division, and it began services on November 2 2016. This Depot provides services for East Ring Line, Urban Line, Urban Express, New Edward Line, Kinight Line, Ingress Line, Oasis Bay Line, Egress Line, Interisland Line, Gondola Line, Stadow Line, Cometsilk Line, Charlie Line, and Lima Line, as well as maintenance services for Flask Line, Glacier Line and Glacier Express trains. This Depot Spans the Kaling Channel, Incident Bay and Vector Bay areas of Downtown, and trains can perform maintenance works in this depot. This depot was formerly the largest depot in Nazca Railway, but was later taken over by the Centopia Depot on July 8 2020. However, this depot once again became the largest depot in terms of Capacity on August 23 when it expanded to provide spaces for 60 additional 9-Carriage Trains in response to the Lima Line extension to Metropolis Terminal.
